project_name.justification: The article is titled: "Maritime Resources Stakes Black Ridge Property with Outcrop Grades of 8.8 gpt Gold, 198.6 gpt Silver and 10.3% Copper".

company_name.justification: The press release is from "Maritime Resources Corp. (TSXV: MAE) (OTC Pink: MRTMF) ("Maritime" or the "Company")" which "is pleased to report it has staked the Black Ridge volcanic massive sulphide (VMS) target".

ceo_buyer.justification: The document is signed "On Behalf of the Board: Garett Macdonald, MBA, P.Eng. President and CEO".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction is described as "staking" claims, which typically implies 100% interest, but no specific percentage of interest acquired is mentioned in the text.

primary_commodity.justification: The headline mentions multiple commodities: "Outcrop Grades of 8.8 gpt Gold, 198.6 gpt Silver and 10.3% Copper". Gold is listed first, and the company describes itself as a "gold exploration and development company".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the staking of the Black Ridge property by Maritime Resources Corp., which matches the project of interest.

currency.justification: The transaction is the staking of claims and no financial consideration or currency is mentioned in the press release.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is the staking of claims and no cash payment is mentioned.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is the staking of claims and no share payment is mentioned.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction is the staking of claims and no combined cash and share payment is mentioned.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction is the staking of claims and no shares were issued as consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters was mentioned in the text.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text states that "an exploration program... will be planned for Spring 2024" but does not specify a monetary value for the commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: No Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) was mentioned as being acquired or retained in the transaction.

coverage_area_raw.justification: "Newly staked claims cover 150 hectares of highly prospective VMS ground..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: "Newly staked claims cover 150 hectares of highly prospective VMS ground..."

resource_size.justification: The text provides historical sample grades from outcrops (e.g., "10.0 grams per tonne '(gpt)' gold") but does not state a quantified mineral resource estimate with a total mass or volume. The property is described as being at an "early stage of exploration".

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Maritime Resources Corp. (TSXV: MAE) (OTC Pink: MRTMF)".
